summary: McKesson Corp filed an 8-K reporting that certain subsidiaries entered into an amendment to an existing credit agreement to establish a $2.25 billion senior secured term B loan facility due 2032. Interest is at Adjusted Term SOFR plus 2.25% or Base Rate plus 1.25%, with the initial rate set at the SOFR option. Obligations are secured by substantially all assets of the borrower and certain U.S. subsidiaries. The facility includes maximum total net leverage and minimum interest coverage covenants. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation event; no acquisition, divestiture, or strategic change is involved.
